name: last24hours
description: Real-time forecasting and topic-scoped market-watchlist discovery across Polymarket, Kalshi, official NWS weather data, X, Reddit, Hacker News, sports, elections, macro, crypto, and the web, focused on the last 24 hours.
author: Jaskaran Singh

SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY.description: ScrapeCreators API key (covers Reddit, TikTok, Instagram)

LAST24HOURS_DISABLE_SCRAPECREATORS.description: Set to 1 to keep a stored ScrapeCreators key but skip credit-backed ScrapeCreators calls

REDDIT_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Reddit app client ID for official OAuth Reddit search

REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional Reddit app client secret for official OAuth Reddit search

REDDIT_USER_AGENT.description: Optional Reddit API user agent, e.g. last24hours by u/your_username

LAST24HOURS_REDDIT_SOURCE.description: Optional Reddit backend: auto, oauth, or public

AUTH_TOKEN.description: X.com browser cookie (auth_token) for Twitter search

CT0.description: X.com browser cookie (ct0 CSRF token) for Twitter search

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key for web search

BRAVE_API_KEY.description: Brave Search API key for web search

PARALLEL_API_KEY.description: Parallel AI API key for web search

XAI_API_KEY.description: xAI API key for X/Twitter search fallback
